def: a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth)

occurrences.text: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En–hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
